dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral axis. The perimeters consist of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels with a jagged, high-frequency edge geometry transitioning abruptly from the dark charcoal base fur to the lighter interior ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-grey pixel clusters located primarily on the anterior neck and distal ventral-lateral regions. These clusters lack a central dark core, presenting as uniform high-intensity blobs against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The distance between the two central-most annuli is significantly shorter than the distance to the anterior and posterior anchors.
